definitions.gloss: shoe rack; shoe shelf; shoe storage
definitions.explanation: Furniture or a shelving unit for storing shoes, typically placed in the entryway of a home or building.

examples.japanese: {玄関|げんかん}に{靴棚|くつだな}を{置|お}いた。
examples.english: I placed a shoe rack in the entryway.

examples.japanese: {靴棚|くつだな}がいっぱいになった。
{新|あたら}しい{靴棚|くつだな}を{組|く}み{立|た}てる。
examples.english: I'm assembling a new shoe rack.

examples.japanese: {靴|くつ}を{靴棚|くつだな}に{戻|もど}してください。
examples.english: Please put your shoes back on the shoe rack.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{靴|くつ} (shoes) + {棚|たな} (shelf)

ALTERNATIVE TERMS:
- {靴|くつ}ラック: shoe rack (loanword version)
- シューズラック: shoes rack
- {下駄箱|げたばこ}: traditional shoe cabinet (originally for geta)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {靴棚|くつだな}に{並|なら}べる: line up on the shoe rack
- {靴棚|くつだな}を{整理|せいり}する: organize the shoe rack
- {玄関|げんかん}の{靴棚|くつだな}: entryway shoe rack

RELATED VOCABULARY:
- {玄関|げんかん}: entryway
- {下駄箱|げたばこ}: shoe cabinet
- {靴|くつ}: shoes
- {靴|くつ}ベラ: shoehorn

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, shoes are removed at the entrance of homes and many buildings. A {靴棚|くつだな} or {下駄箱|げたばこ} is a standard feature in Japanese entryways.

COUNTER: {台|だい}
